systems.system: Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest (SIPAO)
systems.platform: SIPAO, implemented by INTERPOL and financed by the European Union
systems.tiers: none stated for Côte d'Ivoire: as of 19-20 June 2019 the memorandum of understanding between the Ivorian government and INTERPOL was still unsigned, with a deadline of September 2019 set by the steering committee, and the visit was to revive implementation in the country

note: INTERPOL's August 2019 newsletter names Côte d'Ivoire as host of the programme team since November 2017, for the INTERPOL executive director's visit of 19-20 June 2019 (memorandum of understanding not yet signed, signature promised as imminent), and for its contact point's study visit to Niamey on 11-12 June 2019. It reports no Ivorian data centre, site or station on the system; the sites and data-entry it describes are Niger's, Ghana's, Benin's and Mali's. No system in Côte d'Ivoire is described as one in which stations enter reports or cases, so no fact.
